Class BillService

public inherited sharing class BillService

Service class for Bill__c operations including fee calculations, commission processing, and amount validation. Provides methods for refreshing bill calculations such as service fees, tips for business, and agent commissions.

Group:
    Service Classes

Since:
    07/19/2021

Version:
    1.11


Change Log

  • 07/19/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 09/09/2021 - v1.1 - Calculates fixed fees amounts.
  • 09/28/2021 - v1.2 - Fixed fees amounts are calculated based on payments charged.
  • 09/29/2021 - v1.3 - Discount refunded payments from fixed fees amounts.
  • 03/29/2023 - v1.4 - Fees are now saved to field ServiceFees__c.
  • 06/15/2024 - v1.5 - Calculate service fees when included with credit card fees. Update API version to 60.
  • 06/16/2024 - v1.6 - calculateAgentsCommissions(), calculateAgentsCommissionsAsync(), CalculateAgentsCommissionsQueueable: New methods and queueable class for agent commissions.
  • 06/21/2024 - v1.7 - calculateAgentsCommissions(): The commission amount is now a negative value.
  • 10/05/2025 - v1.8 - Add encoded adjustment fields to refreshCalculations().
  • 12/20/2025 - v1.9 - promoteCheckoutToLedger(): New method to copy bill and related records to ledger objects.
  • 12/22/2025 - v1.10 - deleteCheckoutRecords(): New method to delete checkout records after promotion to ledger.
  • 02/27/2026 - v1.11 - Update API version to 66.0. Remove encoded adjustment fields from refreshCalculations().

public static Boolean deleteCheckoutRecords(String billId)

Deletes a bill and all its related checkout records in reverse dependency order. Removes all child records including commissions, Stripe transactions, collections, adjustments, bill payments, order payments, and the payment records before deleting the bill itself.

Parameters:
    billId – The ID of the Bill__c record to delete along with all related records

Returns:
    Boolean: True if all deletions were successful, false if any failed

Since:
    12/22/2025

private static BillService.DmlResult deleteRecords(List<Id> recordIds)

Deletes a list of records by ID using Database.delete() with allOrNone=false. Logs any deletion errors to ErrorLog__c with details about the failed record ID and object type.

Parameters:
    recordIds – List of record IDs to delete

Returns:
    DmlResult containing success status and any error logs

Since:
    12/22/2025

private static BillService.DmlResult deleteRecords(Set<Id> recordIds)

Deletes a set of records by ID and logs any errors that occur. Convenience method that converts a set to a list and calls the list-based delete method.

Parameters:
    recordIds – Set of record IDs to delete

Returns:
    DmlResult containing success status and any error logs

Since:
    12/22/2025

private static Map<Id, Id> getCheckoutToLedgerMap(
  BillService.DmlResult recordsResult,
  String checkoutRecordIdFieldName
)

Builds a mapping from checkout record IDs to their corresponding newly-created ledger record IDs. Only includes successful inserts in the mapping.

Parameters:
    recordsResult – The result from the insert operation containing records and save results
    checkoutRecordIdFieldName – The API name of the field on the ledger record that stores the checkout record ID

Returns:
    Map<Id, Id>: Map from checkout record IDs to ledger record IDs

    recordIds – Set of source record IDs to copy from

Returns:

public static Boolean promoteCheckoutToLedger(String billId)

Promotes a bill from checkout to ledger by copying all related records to their corresponding ledger objects. Creates VenuePayout__c, OrderPaymentLedger__c, OrderPaymentLine__c, OrderPaymentPayout__c, and related adjustment, collection, commission, and Stripe transaction records.

Parameters:
    billId – The ID of the Bill__c record to promote to ledger

Returns:
    Boolean: True if the promotion was successful, false otherwise

Since:
    12/20/2025

private static BillService.DmlResult updateRelatedRecords(
  SObjectType relatedObjectType,
  String checkoutFieldName,
  String ledgerFieldName,
  Map<Id, Id> checkoutToLedgerIds
)

Updates related records to point from checkout records to their corresponding ledger records. Queries records that reference the checkout IDs and updates them to reference the ledger IDs instead.

Parameters:
    relatedObjectType – The SObjectType of the related records to update
    checkoutFieldName – The API name of the lookup field pointing to checkout records
    ledgerFieldName – The API name of the lookup field to populate with ledger record IDs
    checkoutToLedgerIds – Map from checkout record IDs to ledger record IDs

Returns:
    DmlResult: Result containing success status and any error logs
